name: Upload an image
description: An illustrative Loom scenario, not live traffic.

steps.name: Request upload
steps.description: You choose an image. The web app requests an upload.

steps.name: Store image
steps.description: The gateway passes the image data to Uploads.

steps.name: Prepare preview
steps.description: The upload triggers preview and thumbnail processing.

steps.name: Add to library
steps.description: The processed image is added to the asset catalog.

steps.name: Show image
steps.description: The catalog returns the ready image to the web app.
